heading: Ongoing care options we are testing.
lede: These are working ideas for ongoing Website Care. Every option comes with a report, and the report gets deeper as the option number goes up.
disclaimer: Proposed Care options for feedback — terms, eligibility and rates subject to Portfolio approval; not currently available to purchase.
separationNote: These are ongoing care options. They are separate from the Launch, Business, Growth and Custom website build scopes on the Services page.

diagram.alt: Diagram: example setup — the review path behind each option: Findings, then Human review, then Owner approves, then Change log.
diagram.caption: The same review path sits behind every option.

shared: You keep ownership of your accounts and source. LDW generally works through named, scoped access.
No option creates a 24x7 support promise.
Each option keeps the easiest safe editing path your site's platform offers.
Findings and scores are evidence for human review, not ranking guarantees.
recommendedNote: A working concept for feedback, not a measure of popularity.

primary.job: Handle the tiny changes for me too.
adds: Small routine text and photo changes made by LDW, with a written change record.
notIncluded: Online-store, catalog, checkout or payment changes.
New pages or features, or redesigns.
primary.report: Health summary plus a change record.

primary.job: Manage the site and handle routine changes.
adds: A periodic evidence summary with a short list of prioritized recommendations for you to decide on.
notIncluded: Large or risky changes, which are scoped separately.
Any ranking, traffic or lead promise.
Work on accounts LDW does not have scoped access to.

adds: A light read on how the site shows up in search (observation only).
notIncluded: A full ongoing search visibility or monitoring program; that needs a separate approved scope.

secondaryHeading: A lighter option and a broader one

secondary.job: Keep my site healthy and watched.
adds: Automated checks and a short health summary.
notIncluded: LDW-made content changes. Eligibility depends on the site and a short onboarding check.

secondary.job: Manage the website and its visibility together.
adds: Scoped individually after a conversation, with no preset allowance. Not offered as a standard option today.
notIncluded: Anything not written into a separate scope.

closingLine: Questions about these options go through the one conversation button below.
